mentions.name: Hydal
mentions.description: Hydal is a product comparison site for electrical goods, currently listing 350,000+ products with detailed specifications and 27,000+ prices. It covers the UK with prices for 27 regions and is syncing retailer prices.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Hydal

Product comparison site for electrical goods, currently has 350,000+ products with detailed specifications, and 27,000+ prices.

Right now UK only, but we have prices for 27 regions, and just now getting retailer prices sync'd up.

mentions.name: Hydal
mentions.description: This app is an electronic product database where users can search through products and view detailed specifications for each product. It provides an API for access, and is currently integrating electronics news and reviews that will be linked to products.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's an electronic product database, where you can search through products and see all of the detailed specifications about each product. Has an API as well.
